config.dp_accounting: No privacy accountant is implemented; this is a client-update clipping and Gaussian-noise defense, not a formal epsilon-delta DP guarantee.
config.tabular_psnr_ssim_note: PSNR and SSIM are computed on deterministic pseudo-images made by reshaping normalized tabular feature vectors. Feature MSE, cosine, Pearson, and sign-match are the primary tabular metrics.
config.secureagg_note: Secure Aggregation rows marked not_directly_applicable reflect the true server-side threat model: individual client updates are hidden. PreAggregationLeakage rows are analysis-only upper bounds.

metric_definitions.mse: Feature-vector mean squared error on normalized tabular features.
metric_definitions.feature_mse: Alias of mse for explicit tabular reporting.
metric_definitions.psnr: PSNR on deterministic pseudo-images derived from tabular vectors.
metric_definitions.ssim: Global SSIM on deterministic pseudo-images derived from tabular vectors.
metric_definitions.cosine_similarity: Cosine similarity between original and reconstructed feature vectors.
metric_definitions.pearson_correlation: Pearson correlation between original and reconstructed feature vectors.
metric_definitions.sign_match_ratio: Fraction of feature signs matching between original and reconstruction.
